_about: Emails to the hospital person who sent the referral, one per status they hear about. Filled by Power Automate flow 4 (m365/flows.md). Never put patient details in these: the case code is the reference. {fields} come from the Referrals row.

en.subject: Referral received: {case_code}
en.body:
Hi {submitter_name},

We received your referral from {hospital}. Your case code is {case_code}.

We start reading it now and will answer by {deadline_local}. We'll email you each time it moves.

To send more documents, use the same referral form and type the case code in "Case code (if adding documents)".

Illumination Health + Home, recuperative care intake

es.subject: Referido recibido: {case_code}
es.body:
Hola, {submitter_name}:

Recibimos su referido de {hospital}. Su código de caso es {case_code}.

Empezamos a leerlo ahora y le respondemos antes de {deadline_local}. Le escribiremos cada vez que avance.

Para mandar más documentos, use el mismo formulario de referido y escriba el código de caso en "Código de caso (si agrega documentos)".

Illumination Health + Home, admisión de cuidado de recuperación

en.subject: Referral {case_code}: being reviewed
en.body:
Hi {submitter_name},

Our team is reviewing referral {case_code} now. We'll email you as soon as we need something or have an answer.

Illumination Health + Home, recuperative care intake

es.subject: Referido {case_code}: en revisión
es.body:
Hola, {submitter_name}:

Nuestro equipo está revisando el referido {case_code}. Le escribiremos en cuanto necesitemos algo o tengamos una respuesta.

Illumination Health + Home, admisión de cuidado de recuperación

en.subject: Referral {case_code}: we need a few more documents
en.body:
Hi {submitter_name},

To finish reviewing referral {case_code}, we need:

{docs_list}

Please upload them with the same referral form and type {case_code} in "Case code (if adding documents)". The sooner they arrive, the sooner we can answer.

Illumination Health + Home, recuperative care intake

es.subject: Referido {case_code}: necesitamos algunos documentos más
es.body:
Hola, {submitter_name}:

Para terminar de revisar el referido {case_code}, necesitamos:

{docs_list}

Súbalos con el mismo formulario de referido y escriba {case_code} en "Código de caso (si agrega documentos)". Mientras antes lleguen, antes podemos responder.

Illumination Health + Home, admisión de cuidado de recuperación

en.subject: Referral {case_code}: still waiting on documents
en.body:
Hi {submitter_name},

We are still waiting on the documents we asked for on referral {case_code}. We can't give you an answer until they come in.

Please upload them with the same referral form and type {case_code} in "Case code (if adding documents)", or call the referral coordinator.

Illumination Health + Home, recuperative care intake

es.subject: Referido {case_code}: seguimos esperando documentos
es.body:
Hola, {submitter_name}:

Seguimos esperando los documentos que pedimos para el referido {case_code}. No podemos darle una respuesta hasta que lleguen.

Súbalos con el mismo formulario de referido y escriba {case_code} en "Código de caso (si agrega documentos)", o llame al coordinador de referidos.

Illumination Health + Home, admisión de cuidado de recuperación

en.subject: Referral {case_code}: escalated for clinical review
en.body:
Hi {submitter_name},

Referral {case_code} is escalated to our clinical reviewer for a second look, and it may not be accepted. We'll email you the answer, or what else we need, as soon as we have it.

Illumination Health + Home, recuperative care intake

es.subject: Referido {case_code}: en revisión clínica
es.body:
Hola, {submitter_name}:

El referido {case_code} pasó a nuestro revisor clínico para una segunda revisión, y es posible que no se acepte. Le escribiremos la respuesta, o lo que falte, en cuanto la tengamos.

Illumination Health + Home, admisión de cuidado de recuperación

en.subject: Referral {case_code}: intake cleared, do not discharge yet
en.body:
Hi {submitter_name},

Referral {case_code} passed our intake review. It is not final yet: please do not discharge the patient to us until you get the "Accepted" email.

Illumination Health + Home, recuperative care intake

es.subject: Referido {case_code}: admisión aprobada, todavía no dé de alta
es.body:
Hola, {submitter_name}:

El referido {case_code} pasó nuestra revisión de admisión. Todavía no es final: por favor no dé de alta al paciente hacia nosotros hasta recibir el correo de "Aceptado".

Illumination Health + Home, admisión de cuidado de recuperación

en.subject: Referral {case_code}: accepted, OK to discharge
en.body:
Hi {submitter_name},

We accepted referral {case_code}. It is OK to discharge the patient to Illumination Health + Home. Reply to this email with any questions and include the case code.

Illumination Health + Home, recuperative care intake

es.subject: Referido {case_code}: aceptado, puede dar de alta
es.body:
Hola, {submitter_name}:

Aceptamos el referido {case_code}. Puede dar de alta al paciente hacia Illumination Health + Home. Si tiene preguntas, responda a este correo e incluya el código de caso.

Illumination Health + Home, admisión de cuidado de recuperación

en.subject: Referral {case_code}: not accepted
en.body:
Hi {submitter_name},

After review by our clinical team, we can't accept referral {case_code} at this time. Reply to this email with any questions and include the case code.

Illumination Health + Home, recuperative care intake

es.subject: Referido {case_code}: no aceptado
es.body:
Hola, {submitter_name}:

Después de la revisión de nuestro equipo clínico, no podemos aceptar el referido {case_code} en este momento. Si tiene preguntas, responda a este correo e incluya el código de caso.

Illumination Health + Home, admisión de cuidado de recuperación

en.subject: Referral {case_code}: closed
en.body:
Hi {submitter_name},

We've closed referral {case_code}. If the patient still needs recuperative care, send a new referral with the same form.

Illumination Health + Home, recuperative care intake

es.subject: Referido {case_code}: cerrado
es.body:
Hola, {submitter_name}:

Cerramos el referido {case_code}. Si el paciente todavía necesita cuidado de recuperación, mande un referido nuevo con el mismo formulario.

Illumination Health + Home, admisión de cuidado de recuperación
